answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49640 Country: India Title: Namaz Question: If I am praying 4 rakah or 3 rakah namaz, but in 2nd rakah after attahiyat I started reciting durood- e-Ibrahim, just in middle of the recitation I realized my error, what should I do now, should I complete durood e Ibrahim and go for 3rd rakah or I go to 3rd rakah as soon as I realize my mistake. Should I have to perform sajdah e sahv in the last rakah, and in fardh Namaz behind imam? Answer ID: 49640 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 140/142/N=02/1435) (1) After realizing the mistake, you should stand up leaving durood immediately. It is not right to complete durood in this case as this is not the time of reciting durood. (2) If you have recited durood to [وعلی آل محمد], sajdah sahv will be wajib, but if you recited less than it, sajdah sahv will not be wajib: قال فی رد المحتار (2:575 ط زکریا دیوبند): وقدمنا عن القاضي الامام أنه لا يجب ما لم يقل وعلى آل محمد وفي شرح المنية الصغير. أنه قول الاكثر وهو الاصح. قال الخير الرملي فقد اختلف التصحيح كما ترى، وينبغي ترجيح ما قاله القاضي الامام اھ (3) If a muqtadi commits any mistake while following an imam, then there is no sajdah sahv on anyone: قال فی مجمع الانھر (1:222 ط دار الکتب العلمیۃ بیروت): "لا بسھوہ" ای لا یلزم سجود السھو بسھو المقتدی لا علیہ ولا علی امامہ اھ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
